diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says VIN, datasheet reading says GND
diffs.evidence: Adafruit's Eagle board file for product 4415 wires header JP1 pads 1-6 to VCC(VIN), 3.3V(3Vo), GND, SCL, SDA, !RESET(Rst) and header JP2 pads 1-6 to GND, 1PPS, VCC(VIN), RXI, TXO, WAKEUP. The part lists JP1 then JP2 (pins 1-6 = JP1, 7-12 = JP2); the second reading lists the same two headers with identical internal order but JP2 first, so every pin's name and function agrees and only the header numbering differs. JP1 pad 1 = VCC (VIN); GND is JP2 pad 1.
